title: Engagement brief
description: Issue #1176 (owner redirect, 2026-09-22): the kit output shape a composed or proposed kit reduces to -- the client's problem, which roles are staffed and why, what the client gets, and how the roles hand off to each other. Matches packages/advisor/src/engagement-brief.ts's EngagementBrief type and its toEngagementBrief() transform. This is a wave-1 type-and-schema contract only: writing this shape to clossys/brief.json in each staffed repository is wave 2 (issues #1175, #1178). Advisor does not write files.

problem.description: The client's problem, in their own words.

sequence.description: Role directories in handoff order: a producer role always precedes the consumer whose need it satisfies.

deliverables.description: What the client gets, one line per staffed role, grounded in that role's own boundary.owns from docs/contracts/role-loop-archetypes.json -- never invented copy.

context.description: Issue #1173 follow-up (docs/DECISIONS.md decision 28): a verbatim snapshot of the hub's clossys/advisor/context.json, taken when the brief is written. The hub record stays the single source of truth and is written only by Advisor; this copy is how a role running in a product repository -- which has no hub checkout -- reads what the founder already answered. Refreshed by re-applying the plan, never edited in place. Optional: when absent, every context field is read as unknown (packages/advisor/src/engagement-brief.ts's contextFromBrief()), never invented.

why.description: For an explicitly chosen role, its own job question. For a role pulled in only to satisfy another role's need, a mechanical explanation naming who needed it.

metric.description: Must match a metric.name in docs/contracts/role-loop-archetypes.json.
